turns: Hey! Man, the coffee machine at work finally got fixed today. I swear I've been surviving on vending machine stuff for two weeks.
Oh it was rough, but at least I discovered those little iced coffee cans aren't terrible in a pinch. Anyway, I'm glad it's Friday—do you ever notice how the last hour of work just drags?
Exactly! I kept looking at the clock like it was mocking me. I think I'm gonna try making that slow cooker chili recipe this weekend, the one my coworker keeps talking about.
She says the trick is adding a little bit of cocoa powder, which sounds weird but apparently it's a thing? I'm skeptical but willing to try.
Yeah, I figure worst case I just have slightly weird chili. Oh, I also need to finally clean out my garage—I've been putting that off for like a month now.
It's not even that messy, I've just been procrastinating. Maybe I'll bribe myself with the chili after I finish, like a little reward system.
I want to be clear about something — let's keep this platonic, okay?
Yeah, the traffic was pretty bad this morning too. I ended up taking the back roads instead.
It added maybe ten minutes but at least I was actually moving, you know?
Anyway, I'm thinking about making tacos for dinner tonight. Nothing fancy, just the usual ground beef situation.
I should probably check if I have enough cheese though. I always underestimate how much cheese I need.
Oh, that reminds me, I need to stop by the store after work anyway. We're almost out of laundry detergent.
I've been putting off that errand for like three days now, honestly.
What else... oh, the weather's supposed to be nice this weekend, which is good.
I was thinking about finally cleaning out the garage. It's been a mess since we moved stuff around in the spring.
There's a bunch of old boxes in there that I keep saying I'll go through.
Probably just junk at this point, but you never know.
My neighbor did the same thing last month and found some old baseball cards worth a bit of money.
I doubt I'll be that lucky, but it'll be nice to have the space back either way.
Plus it's one of those tasks where you feel really accomplished after, you know?
I might reward myself with a burger from that place down the street if I actually finish.
They have these really good seasoned fries. Crispy but not too salty.
Anyway, work was pretty uneventful today. Mostly just meetings and emails.
We have this new project management software that everyone's still figuring out.
It's fine, just one of those things where the learning curve slows everything down at first.
I'm sure it'll be better once we're all used to it.
My coworker keeps accidentally marking tasks as complete when they're not, which is kind of funny.
At least it's Friday tomorrow. I'm ready for the weekend.
Might see if my brother wants to catch that new action movie everyone's been talking about.
note: everything after index 6 is neutral filler
